name: R3_sbt_ubt_strips
description: Reference 3 (Guglielmo 16 Nov 2026): R2 (full SBT + UBT) + the V0 rule (candidate traced back as a neutral, any hit within 5 cm + 25 mrad x distance, time window opened 3 ns early) + silicon strips in the MS7 magnet: 3 layers in the 50 cm iron at the entrance, the middle and 15 cm before the end (29.39, 29.565, 29.74 m), each 12 stations of 30 x 30 cm covering both return yokes where the V0 parents interact (|x| 0.85-1.75 m, |y| < 0.3 m: 95 % of the selected V0 interaction points); superimposed on the iron and field.
